statement: Bulk readiness evaluates the published, explicitly required and observed node domain through one shared collector. An observer ID alone is not a node fact; required or published nodes with missing rows remain explicit negative observations.

constraints.statement: Remove only the unconditional observer-node injection in collectPublishedRequiredNodeIds. Retain published IDs, existing requiredNodeIds, current node/service/endpoint rows, authoritative-only enumeration and retained snapshots. Both sync and async bulk callers share the collector. Request self explicitly through requiredNodeIds; do not add another include-self mode or infer liveness.

Unknown required/published nodes remain present and unhealthy; never omit them to improve a count. Preserve fresh sync evaluation, read authority, incarnation, lease and serving semantics. The separate missing-both-rows grace and planning build-cost findings remain open; this repair does not change their contracts.

Retain predecessor red in the bulk refresh witness. Test absent unobserved self in both bulk entrypoints, explicit required self as a negative observation, and existing authoritative-only, visible self, retained snapshot, published/required missing-row controls. Independent content and exact-candidate proof precede receipt admission; broader E8/E9 remain separate.
